label: CLAUDE_BUILT_CLAUDE_CHECKED

preserved_never_rewritten.statement: Nothing frozen at the freeze commit is ever edited. EXECUTION_ADMISSION.json stays NOT_READY and byte-identical (sha256 in fixed_now.execution_admission_as_is) in every later commit, merges included. It is never flipped to ADMITTED and never rewritten, and the eligibility record is never described as a prelaunch admission.

decide_unchanged.statement: decide() in read_reproduction.py is byte-identical to the freeze. The reader checks this by test and at run time, and the eligibility record binds its sha256. Only the admission check gained a second route; the verdict rule did not change.

frozen_study.path: cas_only_reasoner/FOR CODEX TO BUILD CAS NATIVE COGNITIVE MACHINE/records/typed_pointer_001/admission_unchanged_repro_001/frozen/study.json

execution_admission_as_is.path: cas_only_reasoner/FOR CODEX TO BUILD CAS NATIVE COGNITIVE MACHINE/records/typed_pointer_001/admission_unchanged_repro_001/EXECUTION_ADMISSION.json

appended_later.evidence: The P1b acceptance receipt: receipt_commit, receipt_path and the EXACT sha256 of the committed receipt bytes. It must read READER_ACCEPTANCE_PASS, list all eleven cases in the registered order, match the frozen per-case table (expected and observed fields), be made by this reader and match the environment lock. It is committed strictly after the lock and before this record.

The helm.reproduction-environment/1 lock: receipt_commit, receipt_path, receipt_sha256. Its values are frozen from public historical records. It is committed strictly before the P1b acceptance receipt and before this record.

The review receipt (schema /2): receipt_commit, receipt_path, receipt_sha256. Verdict SOURCE_CONFORMANCE_PASS with no open BLOCKER or MAJOR finding, on a pushed reviewed commit, binding the whole closure (both writers included) and reviewer provenance. Committed before this record.

The reader fingerprint: reader_sources_sha256 (the sha256 of every reader source file, this rule file included) and reader_source_sha256 (one digest over them). It must be the reader that runs the reading.
The sha256 of policy_pins.json. It must equal the value the frozen study binds. It is appended, not fixed here, so this rule holds no policy hash.
This rule: commit, path (ROOT-relative) and sha256. The sha256 must equal the rule the reader loaded; the commit must come before the U17 training result commit and before this record.

attester, statement, rule_on_launch_checkout_before_u17_launch (must be true) and deciding_outputs_viewed: the exact list of deciding outputs (learned-state or panel comparisons, evidence files, readings) viewed before this record, empty if none. A viewed output is disclosed and its original verdict kept; eligibility is never revised in response to it.
Who wrote the record: the runner or custodian, by name.
When the record was written, UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. An audit field, not proof of time; git order is checked separately.
Free text. It is never read as a status word or an approval.

environment_rule.statement: Every lock field is required-equal, driver version and kernel included (Codex R3-I, Q-G). Only declared envelope fields (envelope.<name>: hardware instance IDs, paths, elapsed time, or another declared non-predictive envelope field, each with a reason) may be diagnostic. A historical value that cannot be established is written as the unestablished value and reads ENVIRONMENT_ADMISSION_UNVERIFIED (INVALID) for every source; the current machine value is never accepted in its place. The lock must not contradict a historical value this reader already pins, and it is committed strictly before the P1b acceptance receipt.

order: 1. This rule is committed and pushed, and the U17 launch branch is fast-forwarded to include it, BEFORE U17 launches.
2. U17 trains; its receipt result (records/typed_pointer_001/receipt_unchanged_repro_20260917/result.json) is committed once.
3. The environment lock is committed, its values frozen from public historical records (it need not wait for step 2).
4. P1b acceptance runs in the admitted historical g7 environment; its receipt is committed strictly after the lock.
5. The review receipt for the reader that will run is committed.

6. READING_ELIGIBILITY.json is committed ONCE: after the freeze, this rule, the U17 training result and every receipt, and before the production evidence. Its chronology label is POST_TRAINING_ELIGIBILITY_BEFORE_COMPARISON.
7. The production reproduction evidence is committed once; then read_reproduction.py runs.
never: Never edit frozen/ or EXECUTION_ADMISSION.json, and never flip NOT_READY to ADMITTED.
Never call the eligibility record a prelaunch admission, and never claim it predates the U17 training outputs.
Never accept the current machine value for a historical environment value that cannot be established; it reads ENVIRONMENT_ADMISSION_UNVERIFIED (INVALID).
Never revise eligibility after a deciding comparison is seen; disclose it in runner_attestation and keep its original verdict.
Never write a second version of the eligibility record.
Missing or conflicting identity or evidence reads ADMISSION_INVALID_STOP; it never buys fallback B.
